coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run or drawn rule: its x extent, from 14 pt above the line to 1.5 pt under it. Cell or box: its drawn edges. Tick box: the printed square. Picture pages: the picture's pixels through the page's drawing matrix.

signing.kind: Limited partnership subscription agreement: the investor completes the form pages (3, 5, 7) and signs on page 5 and in the individual or entity block on page 8; a joint partner signs beside them; the registered representative and a principal of the selling broker-dealer sign and complete their section on page 5. No issuer acceptance block.

sure_per_page.3: sure of every place; the custodian rows are completed by the investor (their custodian), so owner follows the column
sure_per_page.5: sure of every place; the joint signature line is captioned joint partner or custodian (co-investor, third party also right)
sure_per_page.8: sure; individual and entity blocks are separate, the joint partner rows belong to the co-investor

3: the caption row Mr. Mrs. Ms. Other over each name column (printed titles, no blank)
headings, numbered section captions, the paragraphs and the page footer
5: no separate date line in the signature rows: the date is written on the signature line
headings, paragraphs and the page footer
7: the state suitability list and paragraphs; headings
8: the state suitability list; the block headings
2: payment instructions and printed bank details: no place
